name: j-promo
description: J promotional video (Remotion). Separate from the app; nothing here is bundled into it.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts JPromo out/j-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17 --overwrite
scripts.render:voice: remotion render src/index.ts JPromoVoice out/j-promo-voice.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17 --overwrite
scripts.render:sfx: remotion render src/index.ts JPromoSfx out/j-promo-sfx.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17 --overwrite
scripts.render:voice-sfx: remotion render src/index.ts JPromoVoiceSfx out/j-promo-voice-sfx.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17 --overwrite
